proofs.text: Write a hold on the low-risk `RULE-1` for its current text and run the auto-approval; verify nothing is written. Add the comment `# the fixture's password` above the test's assertion, commit, record again and run it again; verify exactly 1 file is written and it names `RULE-1`

reasons: PROOF-62 happy_path_only: No proof of this rule names a rejection, an error or a boundary.
rule_text: CI never auto-approves a rule a current hold names, and a hold whose rule, proof or test has since changed no longer stops it

tests.body:
def test_a_current_hold_stops_it_and_a_stale_one_does_not(self, proved):
        assert approve_module.write_hold(proved.root, 'login', 'RULE-1',
                                         'jane@acme.com', CASE)
        assert approve_module.auto_approve(proved.root) == []
        proved.edit_test(TEST_FILE.replace(
            '    ' + ASSERTION, "    # the fixture's password\n    " + ASSERTION))
        proved.record(stamp='20260913T130000Z')
        written = approve_module.auto_approve(proved.root)
        assert _rule_one_written(written), written
